plainText:
Kōki Uchiyama (Japanese: 内山昂輝 Uchiyama Kōki) is a Japanese voice actor for .

==Biography==
Uchiyama was born on August 16, 1990, in , . He became a voice actor as an adult and was commonly cast as male lead characters in anime series. Uchiyama provided the voice of , one of 's rivals in the Unova region, during . He is currently affiliated with Gekidan Himawari.
